crossRefs.note: But let all those who take refuge in you rejoice. Let them always shout for joy, because you defend them. Let them also…
Now my head will be lifted up above my enemies around me. I will offer sacrifices of joy in his tent. I will sing, yes…
Yahweh is my strength and my shield. My heart has trusted in him, and I am helped. Therefore my heart greatly rejoices.…
Then I will go to the altar of God, to God, my exceeding joy. I will praise you on the harp, God, my God.
For you, Yahweh, have made me glad through your work. I will triumph in the works of your hands.
Be glad in Yahweh, you righteous people! Give thanks to his holy Name.
For though the fig tree doesn’t flourish, nor fruit be in the vines; the labor of the olive fails, the fields yield no…
yet I will rejoice in Yahweh. I will be joyful in the God of my salvation!
Rejoice in the Lord always! Again I will say, “Rejoice!”
I will give thanks to Yahweh according to his righteousness, and will sing praise to the name of Yahweh Most High.
My enemies want to swallow me up all day long, for they are many who fight proudly against me.
When I am afraid, I will put my trust in you.
that they may know that you alone, whose name is Yahweh, are the Most High over all the earth.
For you, Yahweh, are most high above all the earth. You are exalted far above all gods.
“You, king, the Most High God gave Nebuchadnezzar your father the kingdom, and greatness, and glory, and majesty.

translations.web: I will be glad and rejoice in you. I will sing praise to your name, O Most High.
translations.bsb: I will be glad and rejoice in You; I will sing praise to Your name, O Most High.
translations.kjv: I will be glad and rejoice in thee: I will sing praise to thy name, O thou most High.
translations.asv: I will be glad and exult in thee; I will sing praise to thy name, O thou Most High.
